name: Alex. McKenzie
bio: Alex. McKenzie of Bismarck was among those invited to accompany the first stage from Medora to Deadwood in October 1884, along with Governor Pierce, and he spent several days in Medora in December 1886. In March 1885 a resolution in the territorial council called for investigating charges of bribes offered by him and others.

moments.label: Named in council resolution on bribery charges

Alex. McKenzie of Bismarck spent several days in Medora last week.
